case.title: Two third-party plugins that declare no peers fail on removed runtime APIs after the 0.1.7-alpha.2 upgrade

reported.symptom: after upgrading to 0.1.7-alpha.2 two plugins no longer activate: @xmanrui/dsh-im fails with `Error: cannot get property "webServer" without inject` and activates no channel; @liustack/modlens logs `[modlens] settings namespace skipped: TypeError: scope.settings.register is not a function`, so its settings UI never registers. Removing both plugins makes `dsh web` start cleanly
reported.runtime_trace: no admission line at all: the packages install fine and the failure surfaces as a runtime TypeError inside the plugin (client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts:192 for dsh-im)
user_hypotheses: dsh-im does not declare the webServer dependency the new Cordis inject mechanism requires
modlens still calls the pre-keyed-slot settings API (settings.register)
downgrading to 0.1.6-alpha.2 fixes modlens (it does not — the reporter verified the error persists, so it is not version-specific)
reported.root_cause: runtime API drift: dsh-im injects the webServer service without declaring it, and modlens calls scope.settings.register, which the keyed slot system replaced; neither package declares a single @deepseek-ai/dsh* peerDependency, so the admission gate has no range to judge
reported.fix_verified_by_reporter: removing both plugins restores a clean start (workaround, not a fix); the reporter asks the authors to support 0.1.7+

deviations: this case is expected to MISS, and is recorded as a negative sample: the label states the real root cause (a removed runtime API), which our engine cannot express — it judges declared peer ranges, and neither package declares any

CORRECTION (found by the R6 adversary pass, see audit/AUDIT_2026-10-26_R6.md §10): 'declares nothing' was too strong. plugin-dsh-im.json does carry a machine-readable channel we do not read — dsh.compatibility.dsh = 0.1.7-alpha.1 plus dshReleases {0.1.7-alpha.1: compatible} — while the profile runs 0.1.7-alpha.2. So part of the silence is our unread channel, not the reporter omitting everything; that gap is registered as BS-13 / T-108
@xmanrui/dsh-im version is not stated in the report; 4.26.0 is the newest release published before the report date (2026-09-23T06:34Z), taken from the registry's publish times
@liustack/modlens 3.26.3 is the version the report names ('updated to the latest 3.26.3') and the newest at report time
the `webServer without inject` half is about a missing service declaration, not an unmet peer range; unstated in the label because a single label can only name one root cause
the failures are runtime TypeError paths; no admission verdict can name them without stderr attribution (T-102) or an isolated probe (M3)

hit.why: no blocked verdict named the labelled row with the labelled unmet requirement
